mapper.select: SELECT o.order_no, c.center_no, c.center_name, o.status_code, cc.code_name AS status_name, o.ordered_at FROM wms.inbound_order o JOIN wms.center_info c ON c.center_info_id = o.center_info_id LEFT JOIN wms.code_group cg ON cg.group_code = 'INB_STATUS' AND cg.is_active = TRUE LEFT JOIN wms.common_code cc ON cc.code_group_id = cg.code_group_id AND cc.code_value = o.status_code AND cc.is_active = TRUE WHERE o.order_no = #{order_no}

SELECT l.line_no, i.sku_no, i.item_name, l.order_qty, l.inspected_qty FROM wms.inbound_order_line l JOIN wms.inbound_order o ON o.inbound_order_id = l.inbound_order_id JOIN wms.item_info i ON i.item_info_id = l.item_info_id WHERE o.order_no = #{order_no} ORDER BY l.line_no
